c: HALAL: no pork or derivatives, no alcohol in cooking; halal-certified meat and poultry; gelatine and rennet checked.
KOSHER-STYLE: no pork, shellfish or molluscs; never meat with dairy; pareve desserts after meat; certified sealed meals for observant guests.
HINDU: mostly no beef; many fully vegetarian (no eggs); sattvic/vrat without onion and garlic, rock salt and no grains on fast days.
JAIN: no meat, fish, eggs, honey or roots and bulbs; meals before sunset on request.
BUDDHIST (shōjin): vegetarian or vegan, no alliums (onion, garlic, leek, chives), often no alcohol.
ORTHODOX LENT: no meat, dairy or eggs; fish only on feast days; shellfish and molluscs allowed; oil-free on strict days.
ITAL (Rastafarian): plant-based, natural, no added salt, no alcohol or processed food.
ALWAYS: ask the guest, label clearly, prepare first on clean equipment, keep separate until served.
